column2: Built into macOS. Words appear as you speak, about 2 seconds behind you.
Built into macOS and made for long recordings. The first words take about 4 seconds, then follow about a second behind you.
Text appears in steps about every 2 seconds. Covers 32 languages, and is clearly more accurate in English than outside it; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Text appears in steps about every second. Covers 32 languages, and is clearly more accurate in English than outside it; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Text appears in steps about every half second, the quickest of the three. Covers 32 languages, and is clearly more accurate in English than outside it; the three step sizes scored about the same.
Words appear about a second and a half after you start and keep up with you closely. Covers 32 languages, and is clearly more accurate in English than outside it.
Parakeet v3 writes in blocks, not word by word: the first text appears about 13 seconds after you start, then every 11 seconds, and the rest when you stop. It covers 28 languages.
English only. The seconds in the name are how often text appears: shorter is quicker but less accurate, and on long continuous speech the shortest steps can drop a sentence.
English only. Text appears in short pieces about once a second, starting about 3 seconds after you start.
